name: RoboForm
description: Audit RoboForm for Business user provisioning and employee access via SCIM 2.0.

config.setupInstructions:
RoboForm exposes user provisioning data through its SCIM 2.0 endpoint. To connect:

Step 1 — Open the RoboForm Admin Console
1. Sign in as an administrator at https://www.roboform.com/business
2. Open the admin console (Manage)

Step 2 — Generate SCIM credentials
1. Go to Company Settings > SCIM Provisioning
2. Copy the SCIM Server URL
3. Click Generate New Token and copy the token (shown only once)

Step 3 — Paste both values below
   - SCIM Server URL: the URL from step 2 (must end with a trailing slash)
   - SCIM Bearer Token: the token from step 2

Note: this integration is read-only — it only inspects the user list exposed via SCIM, it never writes back.

credentialFields.label: SCIM Server URL
credentialFields.helpText: Found in RoboForm Admin Console > Company Settings > SCIM Provisioning. Looks like https://scim.roboform.com/scim/v2/.../

credentialFields.label: SCIM Bearer Token
credentialFields.helpText: Generated alongside the SCIM URL in the RoboForm Admin Console > Company Settings > SCIM Provisioning section.
